column1: # Approximate state shares, percent of the relevant population, hand-rounded for game balance from public Census Bureau (ACS 2023 1-year) summaries and press coverage of them.

# Not exact and not meant to be: the opening world samples around these values (state-demographics jitter). Anchors cited in coverage: foreign-born CA 27.3, NJ 24.2, NY 23.1, ME 3.8, AZ 13.2, DE 11.2, GA 11.6, NM 10.2, US 14.3; disability WV 19.5, NJ and UT 10.9, US 13.6; veterans AK 10.5, DC 3.2, US 6.1.
# foreign: foreign-born share of residents. disability: civilian noninstitutionalized population with a disability. veteran: veterans' share of civilian adults.
